d: SIR in Jharkhand: jharkhand men SIR yani speshal intensiv rivijan ko lekar ek bar phir nirvachan aayog ne samaysima barha di hai...ab 15 disanbar tak dave aur aapattiyon ka niptara kiya jaega... jabki antim matdata suchi ka prakashan 22 disanbar ko hoga...aayog ke is phaisle se yogy matdataon ko rahat jarur mili hai...lekin tarikhon men lagatar ho rahe badlav ne jharkhand ki siyasat ko garma diya hai...bijepi jahan ise patr matdataon ke hit men uthaya gaya kadam bata rahi hai...vahin JMM aur kangres ne aayog ki mansha par saval khare kie hain...dekhie ye riport...
